r09.product: Single native Rust executable serves the native HTML/TypeScript workbench and owns the internal runtime commands; Node/pnpm remain development and packaging tools, not product runtime dependencies.
obsolete_product_paths_removed: Node launcher, backup, restore, doctor and preflight shims

web_and_integration.scope: earlier source checkpoint; later production changes are documented separately

portable.shutdown: forced owned process; not graceful shutdown proof

inherited_private_validation.review: Independent scoped source and result review approved after the recorded fixes; no claim of complete diff coverage.

r09.provenance_limit: The inherited validation was executed on the original private source and synthetic data, not rerun under this public commit. Raw authentication material, databases, browser traces, model artifacts and logs remain private.

r10_partial_hardware_evidence.public_worktree_source_snapshot: byte-for-byte identical after a per-command Git checkout EOL override; source commit differs from the private measured run, and a default Windows checkout may use different physical line endings
r10_partial_hardware_evidence.hardware: NVIDIA Blackwell, non-fallback browser WebGPU on a GeForce RTX 5060 Ti
prior_failures_preserved: An earlier full-release run failed the original 2k committed-edit CPU threshold at 11.108 ms on an older source.

The first later exclusive run failed its outer provenance check because six identical actual WASM loads were incorrectly required to be a one-element list. All 8000 rows and the failure remain in the private archive; this was fixed by checking every actual load without filtering or deduplication.
limitations: One corrected run is not a repeatability or speedup claim.
Double-rAF is a scheduling proxy, not measured physical display latency.
10k is supplementary stress, not an 8 ms gate.
This does not establish all R10 visual/recovery/operations cases, R11, live model support, G4 or T35.
r10_partial_hardware_evidence.raw_visibility: private project-local archive; hashes do not by themselves give public access or reproduce the run

public_worktree_checks.source_identity: verified against the measured current-source input bytes, not against public commit identity

detector_budget.R05_B1_N1_R1: explicitly waived by user, not passed

public_data_exclusions: original private logs and browser traces
